title: 12 Seconds That Changed Human History | The Secret of Kitty Hawk
description:
On December 17, 1903, on a desolate windswept beach in Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, two bicycle mechanics achieved what humanity had dreamed of for thousands of years: powered, controlled human flight.

It lasted only 12 seconds and covered 120 feet, but the world was never the same again. Here is the forensic investigation and real story behind the Wright Brothers' breakthrough.

Welcome to Chronicle Vault — unearthing forgotten breakthroughs, pivotal historical moments, and the forensic truth behind legends.
